title: Memory-machine instructions
statement: For natural numbers $m,d$ and a set of labels $\Lambda$, memory-machine instructions have five forms: a register instruction from the register-instruction set; a branch to one of two labels according to whether the scanned memory bit is $1$; an instruction that sets the scanned memory bit to $1$ and goes to a label; and instructions that move the memory head one cell left or right and go to a label.
